title: ConnectionError While Signing In (oauth.callback)
body:
## Environment

Running Lattice 3.3.0 on Windows 11 24H2 against ca-central-1.

## Steps

Steps to replicate:
* With the journal pane open, kick off signing in.
* Run the stress script to generate load for about five minutes.
* Inspect the journal pane; the traceback appears there.

## Expected

Expected signing in to finish with no errors.

## Actual

Connections start failing after a few hundred calls and recover solely after a relaunch. The gauge shows the number of open connections rising under load without ever falling.

## Frequency

Reproduces solely on the first run after login.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:50 in loop
lattice/ui/dialog.py:122 in on_login
lattice/auth/flow.py:55 in start
lattice/auth/oauth.py:108 in callback
ConnectionError: connection reset by peer (host=ca-central-1)
